verdict.rationale: Bevy is code-first, and its own docs and runtime probe show the whole engine is driven through its Rust API: all engine and game logic runs through Bevy ECS, and the cargo workflow needs no editor for an agent to drive. Because Bevy has no editor UI (community members are still asking for one), API/UI parity holds only implicitly rather than as a documented guarantee. Pre-1.0 breaking changes each release also weaken the API surface as a stable programmatic contract. missing for 10: an explicit documented parity guarantee between any UI/editor and the API, a stable (post-1.0) API surface, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven full coverage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
